mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WEB_BOARD JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE WEB_BOARD.STATUS = 'N' AND WEB_MEMBER.USER_ROLE = 'user'

SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_NAME , BOARD_TITLE , CREATE_DATE , COUNT FROM WEB_BOARD W JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE W.STATUS = 'N' AND USER_ROLE = 'user' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{boardLimit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WEB_BOARD JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE WEB_BOARD.STATUS = 'N' AND WEB_MEMBER.USER_ROLE = 'admin'

SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_NAME , BOARD_TITLE , CREATE_DATE , COUNT FROM WEB_BOARD W JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE W.STATUS = 'N' AND WEB_MEMBER.USER_ROLE = 'admin' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{boardLimit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE WEB_BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND STATUS = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_NO , USER_NAME , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_CONTENT FROM WEB_BOARD JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE WEB_BOARD.STATUS = 'N' AND BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
SELECT FILE_NO , ORIGIN_NAME , CHANGE_NAME , FILE_PATH FROM WEB_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{boardNo} AND BOARD_TYPE = 'C'
mapper.update: UPDATE WEB_BOARD SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USER_NO = #{userNo} AND (SELECT USER_ROLE FROM WEB_MEMBER WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}) = #{userRole}
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO , USER_ROLE , USER_NAME , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_CONTENT FROM WEB_BOARD JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND WEB_BOARD.STATUS = 'N'

SELECT BOARD_NO , BOARD_TITLE , WEB_IMAGE_BOARD.CREATE_DATE , FILE_PATH || '/' || CHANGE_NAME "src" FROM WEB_IMAGE_BOARD JOIN WEB_ATTACHMENT ON (BOARD_NO = REF_BNO) WHERE BOARD_TYPE = 'I' AND STATUS = 'N' AND FILE_LEVEL = 1 ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT BOARD_NO , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_CONTENT , FILE_NO , CHANGE_NAME , FILE_PATH FROM WEB_IMAGE_BOARD JOIN WEB_ATTACHMENT ON (BOARD_NO = REF_BNO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND WEB_IMAGE_BOARD.STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY FILE_NO ASC
SELECT REPLY_NO , REPLY_CONTENT , USER_NAME , CREATE_DATE FROM WEB_REPLY JOIN WEB_MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE WEB_REPLY.STATUS = 'N' AND REF_BNO = #{boardNo} ORDER BY REPLY_NO DESC
